This history has been inspected repeatedly and is development data. A prospective, frozen evaluation window is required before any forward claim.
Interval coverage is measured inside the audit window and carries no guarantee for dependent future games.
Diagnostic groups below the declared minimum game count are marked inconclusive and should not be read as findings.
The market-correction head is unwired research: not in weekly_training.py, no betting authority, gated on beating both the market and football-alone baselines.
verdict: Weekly refit over 111 weeks and 1440 games on common support with the market. Unified margin model: MAE 10.271 / RMSE 13.278 / bias -0.358. Market baseline: MAE 9.779 / RMSE 12.666 / bias -0.536. Zero-information baseline: MAE 10.981. The unified model's MAE is 0.492 points/game higher than the market's. Whether that difference survives week-clustered resampling is NOT decided here: run server/services/backtest-significance.js pairedBootstrapDiff with groups=fit_week, via scripts/unified-margin-audit-significance.mjs over predictions.json. A point difference without that interval is not a finding, in either direction. The nominal 80% interval covered 80.0% of outcomes (mean width 34.2 points). Coverage measured inside the audit window is not a guarantee on future dependent games. Market-correction head (Phase 1): over 1440 market-evidenced games, correction MAE 9.913, football-alone MAE 10.275, market MAE 9.779. Correction vs the market: 0.134 points/game higher (interval not computed here; see server/services/backtest-significance.js pairedBootstrapDiff with groups=fit_week, via scripts/unified-margin-audit-significance.mjs). Correction vs football-alone: 0.362 points/game lower (interval not computed here; see server/services/backtest-significance.js pairedBootstrapDiff with groups=fit_week, via scripts/unified-margin-audit-significance.mjs). Per Stage 3's own rule, the correction head must beat BOTH baselines on the same games to be anything more than a research candidate -- beating football-alone without beating the market proves nothing about betting.
